name: Paurometabolism
source:
Paurometabolism: “Development with incomplete or direct metamorphosis in which the young nymph is fundamentally like the adult.” - Merriam Webster Dictionary

The throes of adolescence are laced with decisions that define the rest of your life. Some people simply grow a bigger body carrying their regrets of that which cannot be changed. While others drown from the weight. 

You cannot intervene. This is a tale with a set path of someone’s painful mistake. 

Everyone has experiences where there was an action or inaction that you desperately wish you could undo. 

You could not change it then, you cannot change it now. 

This is an [s]un[/s]ordinary story about a guy, his “friend”, and a weird bug.

[From [url=https://devilishnu.itch.io/paurometabolism]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
渐态发育：“一种不完全变态或直接变态的发育方式，其幼年若虫在形态上与成虫基本相似。”——《韦氏词典》

青春期的阵痛中交织着足以定义余生的抉择。有些人只是徒然长大了躯壳，背负着无法挽回的悔恨继续活着；另一些人则在那份重压之下彻底灭顶。

你无力干预。这是一段路线早已注定的故事，记录着某个人痛彻心扉的过错。

每个人的人生里都曾有过那样一件事——某个做出的举动，或是某次袖手旁观——让你拼尽一切也想重来一次。

当初你无法改变它，如今也依然不能。

这是一个关于一名少年、他的“朋友”，以及一只古怪虫子的[s]非同[/s]寻常的故事。

[摘自[url=https://devilishnu.itch.io/paurometabolism]itch.io[/url]]
